rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a burden or something that has to be carried.

example.english: Looking after two elderly people is a big encumbrance for me.
example.traditional: 照顧兩個老人家對我嚟講係好大嘅負擔。
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 loeng5 go3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 hou2 daai6 ge3 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this when the encumbrance is an ongoing drag, especially a person or responsibility weighing on someone.

example.english: I do not want to be an encumbrance to you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sing4 wai4 nei5 ge3 fu6 leoi6

rows.note: Use this for a large household item or piece of junk that is awkward to move, store, or dispose of.

example.english: That old sofa is in the way; it is a real encumbrance.
example.traditional: 張舊梳化擺喺度阻住路，真係一件大件嘢。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 gau6 so1 faa2 baai2 hai2 dou6 zo2 zyu6 lou6 zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 daai6 gin6 je5
